sv.title: Amanda Sokolnicki: Nu kan Magdalena Andersson tvingas göra Ulf Kristersson till statsminister
sv.summary: Magdalena Andersson har varit tydlig med att hon kan tänka sig att samarbeta med moderater. Men det hon kan tvingas till nu ingick sannerligen inte i planen.

en.title: Amanda Sokolnicki: Magdalena Andersson may be forced to make Ulf Kristersson (M) prime minister
en.summary: Magdalena Andersson has been clear that she could consider cooperating with the Moderates. But what she may now be forced into was certainly not part of the plan.
